title: OWASP Top 10:2021
excerpt: The OWASP Top 10 is a standard awareness document for developers and web application security that represents a broad consensus about the most critical security risks to web applications. The 2021 edition ranks Broken Access Control first, followed by Cryptographic Failures and Injection.

title: PCI Security Standards Council — PCI DSS document library
excerpt: The Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) defines security requirements for organisations that store, process or transmit cardholder data. Version 4.0 was published in March 2022 and replaced version 3.2.1, which was retired on 31 March 2024.

title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
excerpt: WCAG 2.2 became a W3C Recommendation on 5 October 2023. It describes how to make web content more accessible and is organised under four principles: perceivable, operable, understandable and robust.

title: The Twelve-Factor App
excerpt: The twelve-factor app is a methodology for building software-as-a-service applications. It recommends storing configuration in the environment, treating logs as event streams, and keeping development and production as similar as possible.

title: What is OpenTelemetry?
excerpt: OpenTelemetry is an open source observability framework that provides APIs, SDKs and tools to generate, collect and export telemetry data such as traces, metrics and logs.

title: PostgreSQL documentation — Transaction Isolation
excerpt: PostgreSQL provides the four standard transaction isolation levels defined by SQL. Read Committed is the default isolation level.
